text:
maria: Kicking off PHX cluster networking bring-up. Scope: TGW peering (acct 845210), egress/NAT design, Route53 zones, and smoke validation. Want a short checklist and a handoff owner.

aj: Re: TGW - who has the attach account on file? I think infra-aws-prod is the peer owner but confirm. Also need route table ids to update propagation.

simon: I can attach and tag the TGW. Plan: create dedicated route table for phx-cluster, enable auto-propagation from attachments, then add explicit routes for cluster subnets -> tgw-rtb-04.

maria: @simon please add a note with the exact route table names you will create. We'll want to avoid touching shared RTs.

simon: Will create rtb-phx-cluster-main and rtb-phx-egress. Steps:
```
1) aws ec2 create-route-table --vpc-id vpc-0abcd1234 --tag-specifications 'ResourceType=route-table,Tags=[{Key=Name,Value=rtb-phx-cluster-main}]'
2) aws ec2 create-transit-gateway-route --transit-gateway-route-table-id tgw-rtb-04 --destination-cidr-block 10.32.0.0/16 --transit-gateway-attachment-id tgw-attach-9876
```
I'll push snippet to infra repo.

rachel: Quick capacity note: QA needs 8 A100s reserved in PHX for smoke. We should gate the full egress cutover until GPUs are provisioned and health checks pass.

aj: NAT options: we should avoid per-subnet NAT Gateway due to cost. Proposal: use central egress account with 2 NAT gateways in AZ-a/b and advertise via TGW. Lower latency for outbound and single billing. Thoughts?

simon: Central NAT via TGW sounds good. Need to ensure SNAT ports for peak concurrency. Also update security team for allowed outbound ports (443/22/123 etc).

maria: For DNS: we'll create a delegated subzone phx.redwood-internal. Plan: create hosted zone in centralized account + create NS records in parent org zone. Ops to verify replication to Route53 Resolver endpoints.

aj: Validation checklist draft (short):
- TGW attachment present and 'Available'
- rtb-phx-cluster-main propagated routes include cluster CIDRs
- Egress tested to 8.8.8.8 and external services (pypi/npm)
- DNS delegation NS entries present + resolver rule for inbound/outbound
- Security group egress allowed for telemetry and container registries
- Smoke inference request through hosted API (latency < 300ms)

maria: Add: confirm NAT SNAT port usage under peak (simulate 200 concurrent flows). Also check flow logs for RST/ICMP.

ops-bot: Ticket created: #INFRA-3124 "PHX networking bring-up: TGW, NAT, DNS + smoke"
